policy: Preserve the official train, development, and test boundaries. No labels participate in membership because the upstream archive defines the files.
oracleIsolation: Source validation checks the separate label file's identity, length, and value domain. Only the development collector can join a label to a visible task. No public function loads test tasks or joins test labels, and no test prediction exists.
freshOpeningGate: A one-shot fresh run requires an accepted development method with valid witnesses, metamorphic and contrastive controls, a pre-run behavior freeze, and explicit approval.
